title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：shelf　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shelf 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the grandmother ① fixed the shelf that no child in the courtyard would have recorded, and he said the fixing was the whole of the year. The ② shelf, meaning the board itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a shelf, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ shelf in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ shelf at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shelf, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the grandmother said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shelf was the whole of the matter, meaning the order and not the board. The ⑥ shelf, meaning the order and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; shelf, he said, is either something you fix or the only word that means both a board and an order. He said the order is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ shelf had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ shelf of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of recording; shelf, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shelf I remember is the board recorded in the diary, which closed in 1981 and is still recorded as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ shelf, my mother said in 1983, is the only board that improves by being recorded; every shelf, she said, is an order that has agreed to look like a board. She said the order was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 架子；搁板（指院子里每一层旁边的那一层）
B. n. 架子；搁板（指那层架子本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：fix the shelf 钉这一层架子
D. n. 架子；搁板（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 架子之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的架子之事）
F. n. 架子；搁板（指日记里写到、被记载的那一层）
G. n. 架子、次序（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 次序（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: fixed the shelf that no child in the courtyard would have recorded
The shelf, meaning the board itself and not the lamp
the shelf at the far window
the shelf was the whole of the matter
the shelf had become a line in a diary
The shelf of the whole thing

answers.why: fix the shelf 意为“钉这一层架子”，1974 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯记载的一层架子做了一遍。
shelf 意为“架子；搁板”，指那层架子本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
shelf 意为“架子；搁板”，指院子里每一层旁边的那一层，每一层旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
shelf 意为“架子；搁板”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shelf 意为“架子、次序”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这层次序就是那件事的全部。
shelf 意为“次序”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那层架子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shelf 意为“架子；搁板”，指日记里写到、被记载的那一层，到 1979 年这一层成了日记里的一行。
shelf 意为“架子之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的架子之事是一处院子和三个年头的记载。
shelf 意为“架子；搁板”，我记得的是日记里记载过的那一层，1981 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一层。
shelf 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，架子是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的架子。
